blocks.text: Tamam enzymes pH ki ek tang had (narrow range) mein sab se tez kaam karte hain. Is pH mein thori si tabdeeli (kami ya izafa) bhi enzyme ka kaam sust kar deti hai ya bilkul rok deti hai. Har enzyme ek khaas pH par sab se acha kaam karta hai, jise us ka optimum pH kehte hain. Maslan pepsin tezabi (acidic, kam pH) mahol mein kaam karta hai, jabke trypsin alkaline (zyada pH) mahol mein sab se acha kaam karta hai. Kuch enzymes, jaise kachay papite ka papain, tezabi aur alkaline dono mahol mein kaam karte hain.

Enzyme ki globular banawat mein polypeptide chains mukhalif charge wale amino acids ke darmiyan bonds se jure hote hain, maslan glutamic acid (−) aur lysine (+). Yeh bonds hydrogen ion concentration (H⁺ ki miqdar) ke liye hassas hain. pH badalne se active site ke amino acids ka ionization (charge lena) badal sakta hai, aur substrate ka ionization bhi badal sakta hai. pH mein shadeed tabdeeli enzyme ke bonds tor deti hai aur enzyme denature ho jata hai.

blocks.caption: Aham insani enzymes ka optimum pH (kitab ka table)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke table mein salivary amylase ka optimum pH 4.6 se 5.2 chhapa hai. Insani salivary amylase ka optimum pH taqreeban 6.8 hai (neutral ke qareeb); isi liye maide ke tezab mein yeh kaam band kar deta hai. Figure 5.6 ka amylase wala curve kitab ki chhapi qeemat par bana hai.

blocks.alt: Reaction ki raftar aur pH (1 se 10) ka graph jis mein ghante (bell) jaise teen curves hain, har ek ki choti par nuqtedar lakeer: Pepsin ki choti taqreeban pH 2 par, Salivary amylase ki taqreeban pH 4.6 par, aur Pancreatic lipase ki, jo neecha curve hai, taqreeban pH 9 par.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.6: Kuch enzymes ka optimum pH aur pH badalne ka enzyme ki sargarmi par asar (kitab ki Figure 5.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har enzyme ki apni choti hai, yani apna optimum pH: pepsin (maide mein) tezabi (acidic), salivary amylase (munh mein) asal mein taqreeban neutral, pH 6.8 ke qareeb (khaake mein kitab ke mutabiq 4.6 par), pancreatic lipase (chhoti aant mein) alkaline. Choti se kisi taraf bhi pH badle to raftar girti hai.
